phases.objective: Make local Staging post-build image provenance discovery deterministic and PowerShell 5.1-safe while preserving exact-SHA fail-closed identity checks and leaving Production authority unchanged.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Staging AutoPilot against an exact governed source SHA after the Docker build completes
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: AutoPilot resolves the exact locally built Staging image through bounded Docker metadata discovery, verifies commit/tree/build-context provenance, and fails closed on ambiguity or mismatch without any Production mutation.
steps: Build the Staging application image from the exact governed source tree and canonical build context.
Discover post-build candidate images without relying on PowerShell 7-only syntax.
Require one exact matching image identity and reject missing, ambiguous, stale, or provenance-mismatched candidates.
Preserve the existing deployment-info and runtime attestation checks against the same source SHA.
Do not dispatch, promote, mutate, or otherwise authorize Production from this declaration.
assertions: PowerShell 5.1-compatible image discovery replaces syntax that cannot execute on the supported Windows host.
Image selection remains exact-SHA and provenance-bound rather than tag-only or newest-image based.
The portable Staging manifest is updated to the exact Start-AutoPilot.ps1 content hash.
Generated Remote MCP inventory refresh remains repository-derived evidence and is not an independent environment source.
Production mutation, Production deployment, provider mutation, database mutation, force push, and secret inclusion remain false.
